description: A list argument for a tuple parameter of the same length is an error
notes: The spec's call rules make an argument that doesn't match its parameter's type an error, and a list doesn't match a tuple type. But the spec also says automatic conversion is attempted when a value doesn't match what an operation expects, and its conversion rules convert a list to a tuple type with the same number of elements. hashicorp/hcl converts arguments, but go-cty has no conversion from a list or set to a tuple (getConversionKnown in cty/convert/conversion.go), so the call fails.
